what_i_did: Read lab/TASKS.md, tasks/synthesis/spec.md and dev.json, checked checker flags in lab/core.py, then wrote 21 distinct tasks g3-01..g3-21 with a Python generator: 15 ANSWER-line numeric tasks, 1 ANSWER-line name task, 4 strict-JSON {day, place} tasks and 2 tool-mode tasks (env.docs with search/read_doc/calc). Each uses fictional dated notices, logs or memos where later documents shift, extend, withdraw or override earlier ones, with the precedence rule stated or marked in the document headers.

reasoning_types.g3-01: one relative delay, with a decoy delay for another event
reasoning_types.g3-03: JSON: date from timetable, hall from later notice
reasoning_types.g3-04: closure duration extended, linked to a bus diversion
reasoning_types.g3-05: which event comes first after one is brought forward
reasoning_types.g3-06: elapsed days to a replaced due date
reasoning_types.g3-07: place override by stated authority over a conflicting newsletter
reasoning_types.g3-08: notices out of date order, relative revision of the previous notice
reasoning_types.g3-09: delay propagated through a dependency rule
reasoning_types.g3-10: tool: total slip after two absolute overrides
reasoning_types.g3-11: JSON: four notices, one date change and two room changes
reasoning_types.g3-12: deadline from a rule with a case-specific extended window
reasoning_types.g3-13: tool: shifted start plus fixed interval, decoy memo for another person
reasoning_types.g3-14: elapsed days with a corrected end record
reasoning_types.g3-15: JSON: one-week postponement that triggers a conditional room move
reasoning_types.g3-16: group delay rule then individual adjustment
reasoning_types.g3-17: chained delays crossing a month end
reasoning_types.g3-19: JSON: withdrawn notice restores the original date, then relative delay
reasoning_types.g3-20: working backwards from a brought-forward milestone
reasoning_types.g3-21: elapsed days across a month end with a delivery delay

verification: Every expected value is computed in the generator script from the numbers in the documents (arithmetic expressions; datetime.date for the two month-crossing tasks g3-17 and g3-21; a dict-based rule application for g3-16), with assertions that negatives differ from answers, that conditional triggers hold (g3-05, g3-15), ids are g3-01..g3-21 and prompt+env is under 1500 characters. Negatives are the pre-update or half-applied answers. The model was NOT run on these tasks and other generators' files were not read.
caveats: Difficulty labels are estimates from the spec's pilot guidance, not measured. The generator script lives in the session scratchpad, not in the repo.
